description: This walk explores Fernbrae Meadows in Rutherglen. The attractive green space is located just to the south of the town, next to Cathkin Braes Country Park. The meadows includes a mixture of grassland, woodland and paths to explore. The elevated position gives views across the surrounding landscape, with the nearby Cathkin Braes providing a scenic backdrop.The meadows form part of a wider green corridor south of Glasgow, with the route offering a peaceful contrast to the surrounding urban areas. The neighbouringCathkin Braes Country Parkprovides further opportunities for walking and exploring the countryside.Fernbrae Meadows is also a useful spot for enjoying local wildlife, with the grassland and wooded areas providing habitats for a variety of birds and other species.
